Plants absorb **carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$)** from the air to carry out photosynthesis.

### Key Details:
* **How it enters:** Carbon dioxide enters the plant through tiny microscopic pores on the leaves called **stomata**.
* **The process:** Combining $\text{CO}_2$ with water ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) and sunlight, plants produce **glucose** (energy/food) and release **oxygen ($\text{O}_2$)** back into the air as a byproduct.

$$\text{6 CO}_2 + \text{6 H}_2\text{O} + \text{sunlight} \rightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 + \text{6 O}_2$$
